policy.years: Only explicit catalog year or displayed model-name year; code suffix never assumed a model year.
policy.trim: Null until a real source establishes trim; game display grade is preserved in model/name. No real-world specifications inferred.
policy.families: Broad model groups ignore year, trim and generation to reduce split leakage. Make-level fallback groups are provisional and deliberately broad. Unresolved codes must not be considered independent train/test families without further audit.
policy.nearest_production: No nearest production substitution asserted in this first pass.
policy.unresolved_coverage: Opaque Schtorftris and fictional wheeled APC are retained conservatively, flagged needs_review, to avoid silent vehicle omissions. Cart/toy novelties are explicitly excluded.
